dedupe_keys.name: topology metrics for qkd enabled networks

description: María Álvarez Roa and colleagues publish derived topology metrics for upgrading classical networks to quantum-key-distribution networks. The March 2025 Zenodo deposit covers fifteen named network topologies through JSON results, with three parameter-factor files per topology, free under CC BY 4.0. Its README defines trusted-relay-node requirements, node and edge counts, link distances, key pools and secret-key-rate quantities. Calculations use equal relay spacing as an initial approximation and consider BB84 decoy and COW protocols at 1550 and 1310 nanometres. The results can support network-upgrade and relay-placement simulations. Related catalogue record data-internet-topology-zoo supplies the classical topologies; it does not include these derived quantum-network metrics. Operational validation and transfer to other equipment remain unknown. The README was inspected, while JSON result files were not downloaded.
